summary: First end-to-end test pass for NT Commerce SaaS POS after GitHub import. Backend 13/13 tests passed (100%). Frontend critical SaaS flows (landing, super-admin login, SaaS admin dashboard, tenant creation via UI/API, tenant login, fresh tenant products) all WORKING. Two field-name mismatch bugs found on /pricing (shows NaN 'ليس رقمًا') and /register wizard (shows 0 DZD) - same pattern that was already fixed for LandingPage but not propagated to these two pages. Also a noisy global 'permission denied' toast appears on public pages due to axios 403 interceptor firing on background /api/auth/me calls.

ui_bugs.issue: All plan prices display as 'ليس رقمًا' (NaN). Code reads plan.price_monthly / plan.price_yearly but backend GET /api/saas/plans returns monthly_price / yearly_price / six_month_price.
All plans show '0 دج' for monthly/6months/yearly. Code reads plan.price_monthly / plan.price_yearly / plan.price_6months but backend returns monthly_price / yearly_price / six_month_price.

A red toast 'ليس لديك صلاحية للوصول' (no permission to access) appears at the top of public pages (/landing, /pricing, /register, /portal) for unauthenticated visitors. Likely an axios response interceptor firing for background 403s (e.g., /api/auth/me, /api/notifications) on routes that should not trigger auth calls. Console shows 4x 'Failed to load resource: 403' on these pages.
ui_bugs.selector: axios interceptor or AuthContext bootstrap (showing toast on 401/403 without route guard)

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/pages/landing/PricingPage.js: replace plan.price_monthly -> plan.monthly_price and plan.price_yearly -> plan.yearly_price (line 264). Also update mock fallback objects on lines 61-84 to use monthly_price/yearly_price/six_month_price for consistency.

Fix /app/frontend/src/pages/landing/RegisterPage.js getPrice() switch (lines 108-110): six_month_price, yearly_price, monthly_price instead of price_6months/price_yearly/price_monthly. Also verify any 'savings %' or 'discount' calculations against new field names.
Suppress/scope the global permission-denied toast for public routes (/landing, /pricing, /register, /portal) or do not bootstrap /api/auth/me when no JWT is present in storage.
critical_code_review_comments: Field naming inconsistency: SaaS plan price fields exist in TWO conventions in the codebase — backend returns {monthly_price, yearly_price, six_month_price}, but PricingPage/RegisterPage/SaasAdminPage/AgentDashboardPage/FeatureFlagsPage all still reference {price_monthly, price_yearly, price_6months}. The tenants_routes.create_tenant commission-calc block also reads plan.get('price_monthly'/'price_6months'/'price_yearly') (lines 182-184) which means agent commissions will be computed as 0 for every plan. Recommend a one-shot rename across the codebase to monthly_price/yearly_price/six_month_price.
Global axios 403 toast fires on public pages → poor first-impression UX. Bootstrap auth only when token present.
saas_routes.py only includes sub-routers; no inline endpoints — fine, but route registration depth is large; consider central docs.
tenants_routes.create_tenant returns 200 instead of 201 for resource creation (works, but inconsistent with REST conventions).

rca of the issue: PricingPage/RegisterPage NaN/0 prices: Backend GET /api/saas/plans returns the new normalized field names (monthly_price, yearly_price, six_month_price) — confirmed via curl. Frontend pages still reference the legacy keys (price_monthly, price_yearly, price_6months). The earlier fix the main agent applied to LandingPage was correct but was not propagated to sibling files. Reproduction: open /pricing in browser → all 3 plan cards show 'ليس رقمًا دج / شهر'; open /register → all 3 plans show '0 دج'. Mitigation: rename the 3 field accesses to backend names (or expose both names in the backend response for backward-compat). Same legacy keys also exist in backend tenants_routes.create_tenant commission calculation — those will silently compute 0 commission for any agent-attributed tenant.
